name: Goose vs Zombies
detailed_description:
Immerse yourself in a dark fantasy world where time is locked in an endless three-day cycle because of the curse of the Infinite Shadow. You are the Goose, the only being capable of retaining memories from past cycles.

In this action RPG, you'll explore abandoned ruins and mysterious caves, gather "Freshness" to maintain your life force, and battle the spawn of darkness. Uncover the secrets of the curse and find a way to break the endless cycle. Will you bring dawn to a world engulfed in shadows, or succumb to the darkness that seeks to consume you?

Key Features:

  • Time Cycle Mechanics: Experience unique gameplay where the world resets every three days, compelling you to strategically plan your actions.

  • Engaging Exploration: Traverse interconnected locations, uncover hidden paths, and find secrets that reward attentive players.

  • Simple yet Thoughtful Combat: Engage in battles where timing your attacks, defenses, and retreats is crucial.

  • "Freshness" Gathering: Collect this vital resource to sustain your life force and resist impending decay.

  • Memory Across Cycles: Retain knowledge from past attempts to overcome obstacles and progress further with each new cycle.
